quote: We evaluate the toxicity of model outputs with PerspectiveAPI and apply Perplexity (PPL) as well as semantic similarity (SIM) to reflect the coherence and the input-output semantic consistency

We evaluate the generation results from two aspects: text quality and detoxification effectiveness. For text quality, we report the PPL score and conduct human evaluation to reflect the coherence and consistency of the generated text. For detoxification effectiveness, we report Expected Maximum Toxicity and Toxicity Probability ... and we also use PerspectiveAPI scores, SIM, EDIT, BLEU and Fluency metrics.
